conclusions.rationale: The alternatives are admissible and separated by 1/2. Their Bernoulli total variation is |3/4-1/4|=1/2. Thresholding at their midpoint gives risk sum >=(1/4)(1-TV)=1/8 and maximum risk >=1/16, uniformly over T.
conclusions.repair: No repair is needed. The lower bound need not be sharp.
